summary.en: The next morning, the police carries Soichi away and tell the people involved that Soichi will recover. Kogoro and Conan find some gold dust on the crime scene and deduce that Takumi Kondo might be involved with it since he works in gold crafting. Kondo reveals he only went to meet him and didn't hit him. Back at the house, they receive a call saying that Rintaro Hagino was kidnapped. By listening to the call, Conan deduces they have to go to Komatsu, which has the only airport in the area and that Hagino must be held captive there. At the train station's entrance, Conan and Ran stumble across Saikawa, who was trying to go by undetected and they chase him to a house where Kogoro is in front of, having been given the authority to bring Hagino's ransom money. They arrive at the house along with Kaede, Kondo, Mari and the police which have been called to come. Kogoro finds Hagino and unties him asking him where was Saikawa. There, Conan stuns Kogoro with his wristwatch to expel the truth.
